title: Recent Release, "An American Alien," from Page Publishing Author Emily Vera, Explores a Boy's Extraordinary Life After an Alien Encounter Changes Everything

content:
Dallas, TX, September 16, 2026 --(PR.com)-- Emily Vera has completed a new book, "An American Alien": (UFO) that begins with an encounter that defies explanation. Sofia, a television reporter heading to a party, meets an extraterrestrial being, and nine months later gives birth to Ysidro: a remarkable child who is part human, part alien. As Ysidro reaches adolescence at thirteen, his body and mind undergo a dramatic transformation, awakening exceptional abilities that manifest in unexpected ways. A simple exhale from his lips causes profound consequences, reshaping reality around him and drawing unwanted attention from those who fear his power.

When Ysidro's alien father arrives during this tumultuous period, he transports his son to Mars to introduce him to his otherworldly family. There, Ysidro discovers a cosmos of wonder and mischief, particularly when he encounters his cousin Ballerina, who possesses the enchanting ability to fly and dance within a jewelry box to delight her Great-Grandma Alien. Their playful antics soon spiral into genuine trouble, forcing both cousins to face the formidable Godfather of Powers to answer for their transgressions. Three years after his interstellar journey, Ysidro returns home to his mother, forever transformed by his experiences across the stars.

"An American Alien" weaves together themes of identity, belonging, and the profound responsibility that comes with extraordinary gifts. Readers will discover how one boy navigates the collision between his earthly heritage and cosmic legacy, confronting the consequences of power while learning what it truly means to be home. The stakes are nothing less than Ysidro's understanding of himself and his place in a universe far larger than he ever imagined.

"Through writing this novel, I wanted to explore what happens when two worlds collide and how a young person finds their identity when they don't quite fit into either," said Vera.
Published by Page Publishing, Emily Vera's imaginative work invites readers into a realm where science fiction transcends typical storytelling boundaries. This narrative challenges perceptions about family, acceptance, and the transformative power of self-discovery.

Readers who wish to experience this enchanting work can purchase "An American Alien" at bookstores everywhere, or online at the Apple iTunes Store, Amazon, Google Play, or Barnes and Noble.
